purpose: Reconciliation index; not a replacement for full detailed requirements or evidence of completed PP-08.

requirements.title: Operating entities and profiles
requirements.source_required_control_summary: One core supports MSP, enterprise and group operations; installation, workspace, legal entity, organization and purchasing/paying/issuing parties remain distinct.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Actual parties, payment responsibility, tenancy conditions and sale/internal-allocation configuration; do not reselect or remove operating profiles.

requirements.title: Organization and account history
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Organization trees, viewing groups, payer relationships and contract/allocation pools are distinct; effective-time changes preserve approved historical attribution.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Hierarchy limits, shared-account precedence and missing mid-period history policy.

requirements.title: Actions and delegation
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Read, raw-cost access, policy edit, approval, issuance, download and delivery have distinct authority; policy ownership and author/approver separation are required.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Exact scoped role/field/action matrix, ceilings, approved delegation and exceptional segregation policy.

requirements.title: Provider onboarding readiness
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Authentication, operational read, first data, full coverage, FOCUS conformity, reconciliation and activation are separate evidence states.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Full provider/contract/account-role evidence matrix, actual samples and source access owners; verification order does not narrow scope.

requirements.title: Connectors and capabilities
requirements.source_required_control_summary: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, Alibaba, VMware, HawkEye and TokenMeter remain scoped; distinguish supplier originals from reseller/pro-forma sales data.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Per-profile invoice/export/API paths, quotas, complete export contracts and capability evidence.

requirements.title: Idempotent receipt and immutable originals
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Same identity/content is a retry; same identity/different content is a conflict; corrections are new revisions; equal amounts alone do not imply duplicates. Preserve only permitted billing evidence; AR-05 excludes original AI prompt/response bodies from raw/staging/log/support storage.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Stable source identities, upload/archive limits, delivery mode and revision/precedence per profile; storage selection.

requirements.title: Normalization and monetary meaning
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Source and internal FOCUS versions are distinct; billed/effective/list/contracted costs and sales are not interchangeable; null, absent and zero differ.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Internal target version/datasets, mapping coverage and numerical limits; compatibility evidence.

requirements.title: Evidence and reproducibility
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Approved source, mapping, attribution, policy, FX and engine/module versions plus results remain accessible; URLs and hashes alone are insufficient.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Class retention durations, key custody and remote immutability guarantees.

requirements.title: Supplier and internal-cost reconciliation
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Reconcile matching scope/currency/basis with explained differences; do not force EffectiveCost to monthly invoice totals or invent internal-cost invoices.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Per-basis required evidence and approved rounding components; retain zero unexplained difference.

requirements.title: HawkEye integration
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Accept eligible GPU power allocation and immutable statements; selling is this platform's responsibility; mock/incomplete/unmeasurable evidence cannot finalize billing.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Actual version, supersession identity, full export and authentication contract evidence.

requirements.title: TokenMeter integration
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Preserve input/output/cache, request/attempt/event and evidence-grade meaning; organizational AI cost differs from TokenMeter SaaS charges.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Full export, evidence-grade eligibility and exact fixed-rate input precision.

requirements.title: On-prem cost pools
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Customer-approved depreciation/lease, power, facility, license and operations costs remain distinct from allocation and sales; no double-counted purchase and depreciation.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Cost-pool components/boundaries, idle responsibility and approved customer policies.

requirements.title: VMware measurement history
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Period charges use historical configuration and observations; current VM size/CPU utilization cannot fabricate past monthly charges.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: vCenter/counter history evidence, metering units and allocated-versus-consumed policy.

requirements.title: Organization allocation and shared pools
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Per currency, allocated amounts plus operator responsibility plus explicit residual equal the pool; showback, simulation and final chargeback differ.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Full-pool denominators, residual recipient, boundaries and ordering policy.

requirements.title: Contract periods and lifecycle
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Start, pause, renewal, rate changes, termination and final settlement are distinct; contract end does not cancel supplier subscriptions or delete resources.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Proration, period transitions, termination remainder/grace and customer-specific terms/cadences.

requirements.title: Selling rates
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Pass-through, markup, target margin, unit/fixed/tier/allowance/overage/minimum/maximum modes differ; supplier commitment engines are not rebuilt.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Exact precision/rounding, discount stacking, component policies and approved sequence exceptions; default sequence already exists.

requirements.title: Formula and policy changes
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Settings and restricted formulas are supported without arbitrary code/network access; draft, static checks, full impact, approval and activation remain separate.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Allowed DSL operators/variables/aggregation and separately governed code-extension conditions.

requirements.title: FX and rounding
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Original, sales, display and ERP accounting FX remain distinct; fixed/date/month-average policies preserve quotation units and calendar meaning.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Actual provider/date/average method, currency scales and correction FX; source AR-06 precedence already exists.

requirements.title: Supplier commitment results
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Consume supplied commitment benefits/unused/offset results; do not add purchase optimization or recalculate supplier amortization.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Actual sample evidence, unused responsibility, benefit pass-through and negative-savings policy.

requirements.title: Marketplace transaction roles
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Buyer charges, seller fees, settlement receipts and commitment consumption are different transactions; do not repeat source Private Offer discounts.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Applicable role/channel evidence, offer/fee terms and settlement permissions.

requirements.title: Billing Claims and uniqueness
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Receipt identity, API idempotency and economic billing identity differ; new clients/keys/revisions cannot duplicate the same contract/period/component/scope.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Economic Claim keys, partial consumption units, reservation expiry and correction application semantics.

requirements.title: Prepayments credits and disputes
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Discounts, allowances, cash prepayments, credit documents and refunds differ; one cash authority; disputes do not automatically cancel issued obligations.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Cash/receivable authority, external reservation support, promotional expiry and dispute SLA/hold policy.

requirements.title: Approval and execution
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Billing approval, ERP final-amount approval, issuance and delivery differ; explicit human approval and segregation remain; affected revisions require renewed approval.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Actual approvers/ceilings and trusted external approval; additional input-confirmation role/interaction details.

requirements.title: ERP submission ledger
requirements.source_required_control_summary: ERP issuance mode assigns final numbering/tax/accounting documents to ERP; API and file paths share issuance responsibility and submission tracking.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: External identity, draft/post guards, tax/master authority and recognition mapping/capabilities.

requirements.title: ERP profile validation
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Odoo vertical validation is a proposal; SAP product/version families have distinct adapters, not one generic API.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Product/version/deployment/module/sandbox evidence across intended profiles; safe automatic posting support.

requirements.title: XLSX and manual handoff
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Standard internal/customer XLSX and controlled result registration are common requirements; download does not prove external application.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Per-ERP upload formats, file limits and accountable manual application evidence.

requirements.title: Disclosure and export
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Raw MSP, internal and customer files differ; generate customer output from semantic allowlists and exclude unclassified new fields.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Approved fields/recipients, inference conflicts, link policy and per-profile detail resolution.

requirements.title: Own issuance and internal documents
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Own issuance is new product work; PDF generation is not legal-document support; ERP/own/internal numbering and responsibility differ.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Document/jurisdiction profiles, tax/number policy, templates and governed payment-detail approval.

requirements.title: Corrections and delivery
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Issued originals are immutable; late/retroactive changes use linked difference documents; issuance success and delivery failure differ.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Correction types, cumulative credit ceiling, channel lookup and deduplication capabilities.

requirements.title: Admin overview and history
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Show scope-specific stage/deadline/owner/next action and evidence; do not add costs, sales and allocations as one total.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Saved-filter sharing/search scope and presentation ordering; retain all required screens.

requirements.title: Closing schedules and notifications
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Collection, verification, approval, issuance, delivery and payment deadlines differ; due time is not an issuance command; read/accepted/resolved differ.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Calendars, business hours, channels, escalation and pre-send current-state checks.

requirements.title: AI Assistant entry point
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Use the same authorized business APIs for query/draft/simulation/approval requests and eligible execution; LLM is not calculator or approver.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Model connection/data egress/conversation retention/tool exposure; tenant training requires its own contract.

requirements.title: Common commands and Open API
requirements.source_required_control_summary: UI, CLI, AI, external clients and plugins share one command/permission registry; API availability is not anonymous Internet access.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Canonical command/permission IDs, compatibility/deprecation policy and SDK languages.

requirements.title: Jobs and event delivery
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Technical job states differ from business states; accepted/unknown is not complete; duplicate/out-of-order events are expected.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Leases, retry/retention/cancellation contracts and queue-lag targets.

requirements.title: Plugins and extensions
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Versioned extension contracts/examples are required; core owns originals/calculation approval/ledger; no direct external DB write or admin DOM execution.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Package signer/trust, remote endpoint approval and version compatibility.

requirements.title: Self-hosted installation and support
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Customer-operated independent installation is required; VM/container and conditional Kubernetes assessments do not certify either environment.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Resolve source VM-first validation wording versus conditional Kubernetes preference; actual OS/CPU/network/storage/runtime/support evidence.

requirements.title: Recovery migration and end of retention
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Recover database/evidence/keys/policies/modules/numbers/submissions/outbox coherently; fence old issuers and reconcile external uncertainty before writes.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: RPO/RTO, key recovery, external lookup retention, migration rights and customer operating evidence.

requirements.title: Simulator and independent oracles
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Use the production core after development approval for synthetic cases and independent expected answers; partial public months are not invoice truth.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Pinned sample/license evidence, expected-answer approvers and performance environment.

requirements.title: Scale and performance budgets
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Design for more than one million incoming records/day and at least thirty million/month; one million is not a cap; individual bulk tests start at one hundred thousand.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Record definition, peaks, retention/skew/concurrency, closing windows and hardware/SLO/RPO/RTO.

requirements.title: Reuse licensing and commercial rights
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Compare a small core and OSS by accuracy/isolation/operations/rights; product source-available commercial terms cannot override third-party rights. Expired entitlement preserves retained evidence access; selling this product on Marketplace remains later/conditional under DB-14.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Language/components/pinned versions, final rights-holder/license terms and SDK license; legal approval remains separate.

requirements.title: Release trace and activation
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Connect requirements/source/owner/API/screens/tests/evidence/blocking status; design, implementation, tested and customer-validated are separate.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Named acceptance responsibilities, staffing/dates and actual activation evidence; no arbitrary design exclusions.

requirements.title: Identity and access lifecycle
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Manage creation/invitation/activation/grant/change/suspension/withdrawal/revocation; login users differ from collection accounts.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: IdP/auth/LDAP modes, login ID scope, MFA, self-registration, recovery and external collaborator policy.

requirements.title: Retention archive and deletion
requirements.source_required_control_summary: Manage by data class/workspace/contract/evidence dependencies; retention, holds, physical deletion and backup expiry differ.
requirements.remaining_decision_or_evidence: Basis dates/durations/hold owners, backup expiry/deletion targets, privacy minimization and key/shared scope.

addition_mapping_semantics: HB-14 proposed overlap/crosswalk, not approved canonical trace or new feature count. ADD references are editorial only; runtime NOT_RUN.

additions.title: API upload and other collection methods
Validation correction adjustment and prediction intelligence
Complete authorized cost and usage detail
Monthly ERP recognition independent of billing
Sustained scale and independent user axis
Full scope accuracy cross-validation and operator confirmation

source_hash_semantics: Historical HB14 input/source-screen hashes retained; changed current paths have predecessor/current hashes in docs/reviews/HB-16-remediation/source-revisions.json. Do not compare historical screen hashes as current-file assertions.
